entries.source: #VIOLET#You enter the swirling portal and in the blink of an eye you set foot on the outskirts of Last Hope, with no trace of the portal...
entries.target: #VIOLET#你进入了传送漩涡，一眨眼的功夫你已踏上最后的希望的郊外，传送门却已无迹可寻……

entries.target: #VIOLET#你进入了传送漩涡，一眨眼的功夫你已踏上最后的希望的郊外，传送门却已无迹可寻……

entries.source: This tiny ball of fiery hatred came to the Sunwall as reinforcement from the Allied Kingdoms. He shall regret it!
entries.target: 这个满怀炽烈仇恨的小家伙是联合王国派来增援太阳堡垒的援军。他会为此后悔的！

entries.source: Whoever tortured and tormented this yeti did an amazing job of pain and destruction. As you gaze upon its fur you notice several vital spots reinforced with stralite plating. One of its arms has been replaced with a steamsaw.
entries.target: 不管是谁折磨了这只雪人，此人在制造痛苦与破坏方面可谓干得出色。当你凝视它的皮毛时，你注意到它身上有几处要害部位用斯莱特装甲板加固过。它的一只手臂也被换成了蒸汽链锯。

entries.source:
A strange black disk found in the G.E.M.
You have no idea how to use it.
entries.target:
在G.E.M.找到的奇怪碟片。
你不知道如何使用它。

entries.source: Muscle tissue, extracted from a powerful yeti. Somewhere, somebody or something is bound to be interested!
entries.target: 从一只强大雪人身上提取的肌肉组织。某个地方的某个人，或者某种东西，一定会对此感兴趣！

entries.source: You cannot bring yourself to drop the %s

entries.target: 通向加伯特关押区的路
通向格鲁希纳克关押区的路
通向拉克肖关押区的路

entries.source: I present you my latest orc-toy!
entries.target: 来吧，看看我新的兽人玩具！
来啊，粉碎这具身体吧，粉碎它！

entries.source: I am everywhere, you can't defeat me!
entries.target: 我无处不在，你无法打败我！

entries.source: You should be parked with the others!
entries.target: 你应该和其他人一样被我关起来！

entries.source: You have no place in this new world!
entries.target: 你们在新世界里没有位置！

entries.source: #YELLOW#Mindwall focuses his thoughts on your mind.  You feel extremely confused.
entries.target: #YELLOW#意念之墙用意志干扰你的精神。你陷入了极度混乱之中。

entries.source: A glass pillar containing a still living brain.
entries.target: 一根玻璃柱，里面装着一个仍然活着的大脑。
格鲁希纳克部落拘留营

entries.source: Freedom! Let's rally to Kruk Pride!
entries.target: 我们自由了！冲向克鲁克部落！

entries.source:
Mindwall's will falters and reveals the truth about your surroundings.

As Mindwall's body crumbles you can sense a burst of psionic forces splitting up and flying to new hosts.
entries.target:
意念之墙的意志动摇了，揭示出你周围的真相。

随着意念之墙的躯体崩解，你感觉到一股灵能力量骤然爆散，分别飞向新的宿主。

entries.source: Open the chest with Kaltor's key?
entries.target: 使用卡托尔的钥匙打开宝箱吗？
#GOLD#一件物品从宝箱中掉了出来！

entries.source: A well dressed giant, covered in gold, gems and fineries. Also wielding nasty looking guns at his sides. He seems to look strangely friendly while eyeing your gold purse.
entries.target: 一个衣着考究的巨人，浑身金银珠宝、华贵饰物，腰间还别着几把外形凶恶的枪。他一边打量你的钱袋，一边露出异样友善的神情。

entries.source: As Kaltor falls you quickly grab a big golden key from his waist. Surely this opens the chests.
entries.target: 卡托尔倒下时，你迅速从他腰间取走了一把巨大的黄金钥匙。显然这能打开他的宝箱。
压力强化型防斩击作战服

entries.source: A simple leather armour of excellent facture that has been craftily enhanced with hidden miniature steam engines to enhance reflexes and provide safety features.
entries.target: 一件制作精良的简洁皮甲，巧妙嵌入了隐藏的微型蒸汽引擎，既能提升反应速度，又提供了多项安全功能。

entries.source: When you take a hit of more than 10% of your total life the suit's motors activate for the next turn, displacing you before any blow could hit you.
entries.target: 当你受到超过总生命值 10% 的单次伤害后，引擎会在下一回合启动；每当攻击即将命中时，它都会让你自动移位以避开伤害。
精良的自动装填式兽人驱逐装置

entries.source: A finely crafted gun, designed specifically to kill orcs. And giants somehow!
entries.target: 一把精心打造的枪，专为杀死兽人而设计。不知怎的，对巨人也一样管用！
